observations.reading: The compact grid retains all six graph structures.
observations.annotation_burden: The caption supplies the common key. Condition labels remain beside their corresponding arrows.
observations.reproduction: Both rows and their labels remain legible at the physical manuscript width.

observations.reading: The expanded grid preserves the same six directed operation graphs.
observations.annotation_burden: The expanded grid retains the same panel titles, call labels and branch names.
observations.reproduction: The added vertical separation consumes about 14 mm of page height.

initial_reconstruction.claim: Six directed graphs show the difference between single and serial calls, a gated repair, parallel drafts and parallel reviews, and conditional specialist routing.
quantities: There are six distinct panels and no measured quantities.
initial_reconstruction.evidence_status: Panels (a), (c) and (d) show main paths of simulated workflow families. Panels (b), (e) and (f) are illustrative.
initial_reconstruction.scope: An explicit branch label selects one path. The parallel cases feed both outputs downstream. Result denotes terminal handling.
unintended_inferences: Parallel paths do not establish speed-up. The common Result node in (c) does not guarantee acceptance.

matches: The three simulated families are identified correctly without implying that all six appear in the reported evaluation.
The branch and join structures are recoverable without colour.

audit_warning_dispositions.reason: The figure uses TeX vector drawing and requires no shell-generated asset.

limitations: Human interpretation benefit remains unmeasured by agent screening.
